description: This file defines HTTP handlers for retrieving recent activity data in a web service, including caching mechanisms, data retrieval from storage, and response formatting for a UI component.

classes.name: RecentActivityHandler
classes.description: HTTP handler struct for managing recent activity endpoints, holding references to storage, cache, and execution store.

classes.name: RecentActivityResponse
classes.description: Data structure representing the recent activity API response, including execution records and cache timestamp.

classes.name: ActivityExecution
classes.description: Data structure for individual execution details, formatted for UI display.

classes.name: RecentActivityCache
classes.description: Implements a thread-safe cache with a 15-second TTL for recent activity data.

methods.name: NewRecentActivityHandler
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new RecentActivityHandler instance.

methods.name: GetRecentActivityHandler
methods.description: HTTP GET handler for fetching recent activity, utilizing cache and data retrieval.

methods.name: getRecentExecutions
methods.description: Internal method to query recent executions from storage and process them into response format.

methods.name: formatRelativeTime
methods.description: Utility to convert a timestamp into a human-readable relative time string.
